name: Luxembourg business calendar (default)
_help: Edit this file and restart the server. rules "LU" = Luxembourg public holidays computed for every year (incl. Easter Monday, Ascension, Whit Monday); set to null to use only the dates list. dates = explicit days off (YYYY-MM-DD). remove = days to treat as working days. workdays: 0=Sun … 6=Sat. Times are the local time of the export.
